madhubani.name: Madhubani / Mithila painting
madhubani.origin: Mithila region, Bihar (India) and Nepal. Traditionally painted by women on walls and floors, now on paper and cloth.

features.prompt: a folk painting with a double line border and a floral border pattern
features.description: Paintings are framed with a double-line border, often decorated with flowers or geometric patterns.
features.tip: Draw two parallel lines around the painting and fill the band between them with a repeating pattern.

features.prompt: shapes filled with dots, hatching and cross-hatched line patterns
features.description: Figures and shapes are filled with fine hatching, cross-hatching, dots and small repeating motifs instead of shading.
features.tip: Replace any shading with line hatching, dots or tiny repeated patterns inside the shapes.

features.prompt: a densely filled painting with no empty background space, full of motifs
features.description: The composition is packed. Gaps between main figures are filled with flowers, leaves, birds or patterns.
features.tip: Look for blank areas and fill them with leaves, flowers, dots or small motifs.

features.prompt: folk painting of fish, peacock, lotus flowers, sun and moon
features.description: Common motifs: fish, peacocks, lotus, sun, moon, trees and gods, each with symbolic meaning (fertility, prosperity, love).
features.tip: Include at least one traditional motif such as a fish, peacock or lotus.

features.prompt: faces drawn in profile with large almond shaped eyes and a pointed nose
features.description: Faces are in profile, with big almond-shaped eyes, a pointed nose and a stylized body.
features.tip: Draw faces side-on with large, elongated eyes, and avoid realistic proportions.

features.prompt: flat bright colors red yellow green blue with bold black outlines, no shading
features.description: Flat, bright natural colors with strong black outlines and no realistic shading or perspective.
features.tip: Use flat color blocks outlined in black. No gradients, no 3D shading.

warli.name: Warli painting
warli.origin: Warli tribe, Maharashtra (Thane/Palghar region). Traditionally on mud-wall huts using rice paste.

features.prompt: white line drawing on a reddish brown earthy mud background
features.description: Classic Warli uses only white (rice paste) on a red-ochre or mud-brown background.
features.tip: Use a dark red-brown or earthy base and paint only in white. Avoid adding many colors.

features.prompt: tiny stick figures made of two triangles and a circle head
features.description: People are made from basic shapes: a circle for the head and two triangles joined at the tips for the body.
features.tip: Build humans from a circle and two triangles meeting at their points. Keep limbs as thin lines.

features.prompt: many people dancing in a circle or spiral chain holding hands
features.description: The famous tarpa dance shows a spiral or circular chain of dancers around a central figure or instrument.
features.tip: Arrange figures in a circle or spiral, holding hands or touching.

features.prompt: a flat village life scene with huts, trees, farming, no shading and no perspective
features.description: Scenes show everyday life: farming, hunting, festivals, huts and trees, drawn flat without perspective.
features.tip: Depict daily-life activities and keep everything flat. Avoid shadows and depth.

features.prompt: a rectangular frame with repeating geometric patterns and squares
features.description: Squares and rectangular frames with repeated geometric motifs are central to Warli ritual paintings.
features.tip: Frame the artwork with a square or rectangle and use repeating triangles and squares.

features.prompt: an animal body filled with patterns of dots, dashes and fine lines
features.description: Bodies of animals and birds are filled with intricate dots, dashes and line patterns.
features.tip: Fill the body shapes with rows of dots and short dashes instead of solid color.

features.prompt: vivid colorful flat folk painting of animals and birds
features.description: Bright, saturated colors, often on dark or colorful backgrounds, with flat color fields.
features.tip: Use bold saturated colors and keep them flat.

features.prompt: a large tree with birds and animals in folk art style
features.description: Nature is central: trees, animals and birds are sacred subjects, with the tree of life a popular motif.
features.tip: Make a tree, an animal or a bird the hero of the composition.

features.prompt: fine parallel flowing lines creating movement, without shading
features.description: Fine parallel lines follow the shape of the body and give a sense of movement without shading.
features.tip: Use groups of fine, parallel lines that follow the curves of the body.

pattachitra.name: Pattachitra
pattachitra.origin: Odisha and West Bengal. Traditional cloth/palm-leaf scroll painting telling mythological stories.

features.prompt: bold black outlines with flat colors, traditional scroll painting
features.description: Strong, confident black outlines with flat color fills and no shading.
features.tip: Make your outlines bold and continuous, and fill with flat color.

features.prompt: faces with large elongated eyes of mythological characters
features.description: Characters have large, elongated eyes and stylized, expressive faces.
features.tip: Draw long, wide eyes and keep faces stylized, never realistic.

features.prompt: a decorative floral border around a painting
features.description: A decorative border of flowers or vines frames the central scene.
features.tip: Add a continuous floral or vine border around the artwork.

features.prompt: limited palette of red yellow white black and indigo
features.description: Natural pigments: a limited palette of red, yellow, white, black and indigo/blue.
features.tip: Restrict yourself to red, yellow, white, black and a touch of blue for an authentic look.

features.prompt: a mythological scene of Hindu gods in a flat folk style
features.description: Stories from the Ramayana, Mahabharata and Krishna/Jagannath legends are the main subjects.
features.tip: Choose a mythological story and show its characters clearly.
